sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Purpose The Send email for Out office tool is a critical contingency subflow used to maintain operational continuity when a primary case owner is unavailable. It automates the escalation and notification process specifically for "Out of Office" (OOO) scenarios detected within inbound communications.
Action & Logic
Trigger Condition: This tool must be called immediately upon the detection of an Out of Office auto-reply, signature, or status within an Interaction Record.
Data Integration: It ingests the raw OOO email content and the existing Work Notes to provide full context to management.
Record Linking: It utilizes the WM Record Sys ID to ensure the notification is programmatically tied to the master Work Management Record, allowing for seamless reassignment or backup coverage.
Inputs
Email for Out of Office (email_for_out_of_office): The body or snippet of the received Out of Office communication.
Work Notes (work_notes): The technical notes and history of the current case to be passed to the manager/backup resource.
WM Record Sys ID (wm_record_sys_id): The unique system identifier for the Work Management Record requiring attention.
Key Output The tool dispatches a high-priority notification to the designated manager or team lead, flagging the item for immediate reassignment and ensuring that the outstanding work item does not breach its SLA due to owner absence.
